code: (()=>{const SEL=['.hud-slot-key','.hud-port-key','.hud-slot-abbrev','.hud-slot-num','.hud-port-num','.hud-port-e','.hud-slot-passive','.hud-port-tab','.hud-bn-label','.hud-bn-num','.tm-badge'];const vis=(n)=>{const r=n.getBoundingClientRect();const cs=getComputedStyle(n);return r.width>0.5&&r.height>0.5&&cs.display!=='none'&&cs.visibility!=='hidden'&&Number(cs.opacity)>0.05};const nodes=[];for(const s of SEL)for(const n of document.querySelectorAll(s))if(vis(n))nodes.push({sel:s,txt:(n.textContent||'').trim().slice(0,6),r:n.getBoundingClientRect()});const hits=[];for(let i=0;i<nodes.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<nodes.length;j++){const a=nodes[i].r,b=nodes[j].r;const ox=Math.min(a.right,b.right)-Math.max(a.left,b.left);const oy=Math.min(a.bottom,b.bottom)-Math.max(a.top,b.top);if(ox>0.5&&oy>0.5)hits.push({a:nodes[i].sel+'"'+nodes[i].txt+'"',b:nodes[j].sel+'"'+nodes[j].txt+'"',ox:Math.round(ox),oy:Math.round(oy)})}return {glyphs:nodes.length,overlaps:hits.length,hits:hits.slice(0,6),boxes:nodes.map(n=>[n.sel.replace('.hud-','').replace('-',''),n.txt,Math.round(n.r.x),Math.round(n.r.y),Math.round(n.r.width),Math.round(n.r.height)])};})()
